tei:div.tei:p: 389) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: myur lam 'pho ba'i gdams pa bde chen lam bzang bzhugs: 390)na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: chos nyid mngon gyur rnal 'byor gyis: gzhan phan 'gro ba rjes 'dzin phyir: myur lam bde chen lam bzang bstan: sa ma ya: rnam dag byang chub sems bskyed nas: lha yi sa ma dhi yi ngang: rjes 'dzin cho ga 'di ltar bya: dmigs rten sbyong dang rnam shes bkug: phyi yi stong ra bsgom pa ni: āḥ khyod lus a 'thas 'khrul snang phung po 'di: rdo rje rnal 'byor dmar mo gri thod 'dzin: spyan gsum mkhar gzigs zhabs gnyis gar stabs rol: sku la mkha' 'gro'i chas rdzogs zhi ma khro: dbu skra gyen brdzes thod skam rtse bran mdzes: pad nyi bam steng ye shes klong du bzhugs: snang la 'dzin med chu zla ji bzhin gsal: sku dbus dwangs ma'i rtsa mchog kun 'dar ma: mtshan nyid bzhi ldan yar sne spyi bor zug: mar sne lte 'og tshigs kyis 'gags pa las: snying gar rnam shes ngo bo thig le ni: kha dog lnga ldan ma sar sgo nga tsam: ye shes rlung gis 'phar 'dar g.yo bar bsgom: spyi bor rigs bdag 'od snang mtha' yas ni: dmar gsal mtshan dpe rab rdzogs 391)skyil krung bzhugs: gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kun: nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bur bzhugs par bsgom: rnam shes ngo bo thig le bkrag 'bar ba: dbu ma'i lam nas spyi bo'i rgya mthongs khar: snang mtha'i thugs dang dbyer med 'dres par bsam: phaṭa: phaṭaḥ phaṭa: ces brjod nas 'pho ba sgo 'byed kyi gsol 'debs 'di ltar gdab bo: 'od dpag med pa'i gsol 'debs dang: gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi mtshan brjod mthar: sgo 'byed gsol 'debs ni: e ma hoḥ mkha' dbyings rnam dag chos sku'i gzhal yas nas: chos sku yum chen kun tu bzang mo la: gsol ba 'debs so 'pho ba'i sgo phyes la: rnam shes dbu ma'i lam nas bde chen drongs:

rang gsal ma 'gags 'od lnga'i gzhal yas nas: longs sku rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor mar: gsol ba= rnam shes= gsal stong 'dzin pa bral ba'i gzhal yas nas: sprul sku kun gzigs mtsho rgyal lab sgron mar: gsol ba= rnam shes= chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i mkha' klong nas: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs 392)la gsol ba 'debs: zab lam 'pho ba'i gsang sgo 'byed pa dang: rnam shes dbu ma'i lam nas bde chen drongs: me long ye shes gsal ba'i mkha' dbyings nas: dkar mo bzhad pa ma la gsol= zab lam= rnamashes= mnyam nyid ye shes chen po'i 'od klong nas: ser mo don grub ma la= zab lam= rnam shes= sor rtogs ye shes pad+ma 'od ldan nas: dmar mo sgra sgrogs ma la= zab lam= rnam shes= bya grub ye shes chen po'i mkha' klong nas: sna tshogs mthar phyin ma la= zab lam= rnam shes= rig stong mtha' bral dbu ma'i gzhal yas nas: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la= zab lam= rnam shes= rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer dmigs yul gyi snying gar phog pas rnam par shes pa 'phar ling ling du dbu ma'i lam la bskyod par bsam la: dbugs thengs gcig la/ āḥ lnga brjod pa dang mnyam du/ rnam par shes pa spyi gtsug nas rgyang gis thon te rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs klong dang gnyis su med par 'dres par bsam la: hika sgra gsum gyis dbyings su spar nas: slar yang gsol ba 'debs pa ni: hrīḥ bag chags las nyon 393) 'khrul dbang drag po yis: 'jigs rung bar dor 'khyams pa'i tshe 'das la: thugs rjes gzigs shig skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum: byin gyis rlobs shig sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: lam sna drongs shig rigs lnga'i ḍā ki rnams: bar chad sol cig 'jig 'das srung ma'i tshogs: lam sna drongs shig rigs lnga'i ḍā ki rnamasaḥ bar chad sol cig 'jig 'das srung ma'i tshogs: dbang mchog skur cig 'khor lo'i mgon po rje: bar do rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs:

mkha' spyod lam sna zin par byin gyis rlobs: zab lam 'pho bas mkha' spyod 'grub pa dang: phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan srid zin par shog: phaṭaḥsprul sku/ phaṭaḥlongs sku/ phaṭaḥchos sku/ phaṭaḥngo bo nyid sku/ phaṭaḥmi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku ste sku lnga ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid du sangs rgyas par bsam la dar gcig mnyam par bzhag go: de nas 'dod yon bsngo ba sogs byas te: rjes su: dmigs yul gyi phung po lhar gsal 'od du zhu nas rigs bdag la thim: de nyid tshon gang du gyur ba yar yar 'phag nas bde chen dag pa'i zhing du kun tu bzang mo'i thugs dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsam: phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ ngo shes rtsal rdzogs brtan pa thob par bsam mo: de nas shi rgab gcod phyir shis brjod bya'o: 394)snying rje'i yul gyur rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs: 'pho ba'i gdams pa bde chen lam bzang 'di: sngon chad ma grags mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i mdzod: bdag nyid shel dkar rdo rje zhi ba mtshor: rje mo ye shes mtsho rgyal mnog chos su: gdams pa ma 'ongs don du gter du sbas: las can ḍā ki'i rigs dang 'phrad par smon: rdo rje drag mo rgyal la gter gnyer bcol: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'di 'phrad nas: bye ma'i grangs kyi 'gro ba 'dren par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di'ang bla ma dpal 'od sogs kyi yang yang bskul ngo ma ldog tsam du gsang lung dben khrod nas su kha badz+ra gyis b.ris pa'o// zhar la 'chi kha'i gsal 'debs chung zad spro na/ rang la sngar bla mas gdams pa gsungs pa rnams nyams 'og tu chud par bya ba gal che ste 'chi ba'i nad kyis thebs nas 'byung bzhi'i thim rim sogs khams kyi bye brag gis ngos zin mi zin sna tshogs yod kyang: gzugs sgra sogs kyi dbang shes dbyings su nub pa'i rtags su mig gis gzugs snang thams cad rgyang ring por song bar snang zhing mi gsal ba dang:

de bzhin du sgra dri la sogs pa thams cad mi gsal zhing rgyang ring por song bar snang nas shes pa phral phrol lang long ma nges pa 'byung ngoḥ de skabs su rang gis blo thag rbad kyis bcad nas 395)nye 'brel dang rgyu nor longs spyod thams cad blos btang nas: bla ma dkon mchog gi zhing sar 'bul ba sogs byed pa rab: min kyang yid la ci yang mi sems par rang la bla mas gdams pa'i man ngag gi don dran par byas la: da ni bdag mi gnas chos sku'i gtan srid zin par byed do snyam nas rig pa gzengs bstod: snang ba zhur phyungs: bla ma la gsol ba dung nge ba zhig btab nas rang rig bsam brjod dang bral bar bzhag tshe: snang ba mched par thim: mched pa nyer thob la thim: nyer thob 'od gsal la thim skabs gdod ma gzhi'i klong du grol bar nges so: yang nad drag po sogs kyis rang gis de ltar ma lcogs kyang: bla ma bzhugs yod na rab: min kyang mched grogs dam tshig gtsang la zhig gi 'di skad brjod: kye: rigs kyi bu khyod bde bar gshegs pa yin pas: chos nyid bar dor rang snang lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'phrad par yod pas: de ka rang snang du ngo shes par gyis shig: ka dag gi gdangs dang ma bral bar gyis shig: rang snang ngo shes pa dang grol ba dus mnyam pa yis pas: ma yengs par bde bar gshegs shig: slar ma ldog cig: ces lan gsum gyis gsal gdab pas gong dang grol ba la khyad par med pa yin no: 396)ces pa 'di ni bla ma kun chos kyis 'dod don ltar bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: 'pho ba'i gsol 'debs thugs rje'i lcags kyu ye shes lam bzang bzhugs: na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: gzhan phan sems bskyed byang chub lam brtson thabs: 'pho ba'i gsol 'debs ye shes lam bzang bstan: dad mos drag po'i ngang nas 'di ltar brjod: e ma ho: kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje sems: dga' rab rje dang pad 'byung mi ma lar:

gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigasaḥ zab lam 'pho bas mkha' spyod 'grub pa dang: bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs: ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: bai ro can na nam snying zhi ba mtshor: gsol ba= zab lam= bde ba can= pad+ma las 'brel klong chen rab 'byams dang: pad+ma gling pa bdud 'joms dpa' bo rje: gsol ba= zab lam= bde ba can= rigs kun yongs 'dus 'khor lo'i mgon po mchog: pad+ma 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pa la: gsol ba= zab lam= bde ba can= gnas yul zhing skyong rtsa gsum ḍā ki dang: dam can gter bdag rnams la gsol ba 'debs: zab lam 'pho bas mkha' 397)spyod 'grub pa dang: bde ba can gyi zhing du lam sna drengs: rang rig 'gyur med btsan sa zin par shog: dbugs thengs gcig la: āḥ tshar lnga brjod mthar phaṭa kyis dbyings su bsre'o: phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ ces brjod 'di la brtson gyur na: rang gzhan don gnyis ngang gis 'byung: phyi ma dpal ri bde chen zhing: rig 'dzin pad+ma'i zhabs drung du: gang 'brel dang bcas 'khod par nges: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di'ang skyes bu dam pa don li'i bka' bskul phebs tshe ma ldog tsam du su kha badz+ra gyis nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// 398)
